notes_blind_original: Report (I4R DP 224, Pawel, Kutlar & Knopfle 2025) reproduced from the analysis data only (raw data not shipped; scope matches claims file). Initial obstacles: Git LFS-tracked .RData model files load as pointer files unless `git lfs pull` is run (undocumented; OSF mirror unusable), absolute paths, missing library() calls, and dependence on objects from the cleaning script. These were fixed without changing the analysis and the report concludes 'our computational reproduction was successful'. A reconciler might rate the LFS/OSF issue a P3 documentation problem; it does not change any number. Q, I2 and N are only verified via the reproduced figure image (report PDF p.13), not in report text. The report says 'In the initial attempt the meta-analyses were not computationally reproducible'. A strict reading of 'cannot be executed as shipped' could point to technical failure. I did not list it as an alternative because the fixes (git lfs pull, paths, library calls) are standard setup and change no numbers.
